channel.title: eSportly · What's new
channel.description: What’s new in each version of eSportly.

item.title: 1.1 · public beta, October 2026
item.description:
• “My team” home: your team’s page in its colors as soon as you open the app.
  • 14 games, including StarCraft II, EA Sports FC and Wild Rift.
  • eSportly+: unlimited teams, per-team alerts, app icons (7-day trial).
  • Apple TV: every live match on the big screen, and video sent from your iPhone with AirPlay.
  • The score on Apple Watch and in CarPlay.
  • Time-sensitive alerts, a Control Center button, Home Screen quick actions.
  • Shared match links open directly in the app.
  • Easier to read with very large text, Siri in five languages.
